ns2:course.label: Environment and Sustainability Field Expedition
ns2:course.description: Group expedition to study environment and sustainability issues at a field site. Includes in-class meetings, student-led presentation, and field trip; expeditions run during spring break, winter break, in mid-May or in intercession; dates depend on location. Field Trip and field trip fee required. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated up to 12 hours in separate terms if topics vary.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated up to 12 hours in separate terms if topics vary.
